name: minimatch-compat
description: Gives every consumer of minimatch (CommonJS or ESM, 3.x or 10.x style) the patched minimatch 11.0.1, which npm only offers as ESM-first with named exports. Needed until Stryker, eslint 9 (inside addons-linter) and multimatch (inside web-ext) release versions that accept 11.
